# Verdun

> Verdun is a remote video monitoring service, backed by Y Combinator. AI agents review every alarm on your cameras, and trained operators respond to real threats with talk-down, dispatch, and notification. "We built the world’s most advanced monitoring center."

Verdun (Enari Inc., dba Verdun) monitors commercial, multifamily, and industrial properties. Customers tell Verdun what to look for. AI agents watch every camera, dismiss the noise, log what’s routine, and escalate what’s real to human operators, who talk down intruders through on-site speakers, dispatch police or guards, and notify the customer.

## Common questions

- **What is Verdun?** Verdun is a remote video monitoring service, backed by Y Combinator. AI agents review every alarm. Trained operators respond to real threats. We built the world’s most advanced monitoring center.
- **How is Verdun different from traditional video monitoring?** Traditional monitoring centers are flooded with more alarms than people can get through. When activity spikes, the queue backs up and a real threat waits its turn. At Verdun, AI agents review every alarm in parallel. They dismiss the noise, log what’s routine, and escalate what’s real or uncertain.
- **How fast does an operator see a real threat?** Anything real or uncertain is reviewed by a human in under 90 seconds. At a traditional center during peak hours, a real threat can wait 20+ minutes before an operator even opens it.
- **Can I choose what Verdun looks for?** Yes. Tell us what you want to monitor for: theft, loitering, fire, weapons, trespassing and more. Our AI looks for it and our human operators act on it. Arming schedules and response rules reflect how each property operates.
- **What happens when there is a real threat?** Verified threats go to our operators, trained on your site’s protocol, for talk-down, dispatch, and notification. The operator gets the clip, a live view, the agent’s assessment, and your protocol on one screen. They talk down intruders through on-site speakers, dispatch police or guards, and send your team an update the agent has already drafted.
- **Are Verdun’s operators available around the clock?** Our human operators are active 24/7 to review alerts. They aren’t bogged down trying to clear a queue, so they pay real attention to your property.
- **What kinds of properties does Verdun monitor?** One console across commercial, multifamily, and industrial properties.
- **Does Verdun work with my existing cameras?** Yes. Provide us with your deployment details: network information and camera or device credentials. We hook up to your cameras, configure our AI for your use cases, then test for a few days. We can have you up and running within days.
- **Do I get reports?** Yes. Daily reports show how many alarms we reviewed, how fast we reviewed them, and any incidents at your property.
- **What if Verdun misses something?** If AI or human error causes a miss that leads to damage, we’ll reimburse you up to $20,000.
- **Can I try Verdun before switching?** If you have monitoring today and your deployment supports it, we’ll monitor side by side with your current provider for free. We agree up front on what counts. You can also start us at your next site with a 30 day pilot and nothing to cancel.
- **Do you work with integrators and security dealers?** Yes. Add monthly recurring revenue to every camera that you install. We run the service and it’s your name on the contract.
- **Who founded Verdun?** Verdun was founded by Sonny Tai, a former US Marine officer and the founder of Actuate, and Tung Hoang, who holds a PhD in Applied Mathematics and built Actuate’s first gun-detection AI model.
